*{{cite press release |date=2014-05-02 |script-title=ko:주요 한식명 로마자 표기 및 표준 번역 확정안 공지 |url=http://www.korean.go.kr/front/board/boardStandardView.do?board_id=4&mn_id=17&b_seq=1465 |website=[[National Institute of Korean Language]] |language=ko |access-date=2017-03-16 |archive-date=2017-02-15 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20170215021506/http://www.korean.go.kr/front/board/boardStandardView.do?board_id=4&mn_id=17&b_seq=1465 |url-status=live }}</ref> ({{Korean|hangul=미역국}}), also rendered as '''''miyuk guk''''' or '''seaweed soup''',<ref name="standardized" /> is a non-spicy Korean soup whose main ingredient is ''[[miyeok]]'' (seaweed). It is traditionally eaten as a birthday dish in honor of one's mother and by women who have given birth for several months postpartum.
